game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 4: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Portability.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
